title: Taking a Fiscal Year's Per-Unit Capital Retain to a Member's Membership and Patronage Equity Balance
content:
The per-unit capital retain a member contributes for a fiscal year under Membership and Patronage Equity is a capital subscription and not a share of earnings, so it is taken on the volume of business the class lists whether or not the board declares anything for the year.

The capital retain for a year is worked out only once the equity ledger carries the whole of that year's qualifying volume on the streams the class lists.

The observable effect is a capital retain line on the member's equity account for that fiscal year, recorded against the stream named and dated today. The member's equity grows by the amount credited; no allocation is declared and no cash moves, and the member sees the retain as a separate credit line on the equity statement for the year.

## Making the entry

The entry is made with the agent-side tool `record_capital_retain_31b65d0b`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call adds one capital retain line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `membership_id` | the internal reference number of the equity membership the retain is credited to | an identifier, as returned by the equity membership lookup |
| `fiscal_year` | the cooperative fiscal year the retain belongs to | a four-digit fiscal year, such as 2026; the fiscal year ends 31 August and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, and there is no empty value |
| `allocation_basis` | the stream of business the retain line is recorded against | one of `grain_bushels`, `input_dollars`, `energy_gallons`, `feed_tons`, `service_dollars` |
| `retain_amount` | the capital retained and credited to the member's equity on this line | USD to 2 decimal places, half a cent rounding up, never negative |

**The enum in full.** `grain_bushels` records the retain against bushels of grain marketed through the cooperative; `input_dollars` against dollars spent on a crop input account; `energy_gallons` against gallons of propane or refined fuel delivered; `feed_tons` against tons of feed milled or delivered; `service_dollars` against dollars billed for custom application or other field services.

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence naming the equity ledger reference minted for the retain line, the amount credited to equity, the stream it was recorded against and the fiscal year it belongs to. The sentence appearing at all is what indicates the retain was written; a failure raises instead of returning.
